size_note: closed 88 x 49 x 21 mm (GSMArena, gsmchoice). Shown open: the keypad flap hangs below the body; the open length is measured on a straight-on photo of the open phone (via Koks): 138 mm, the part above the flap's hinge 87 mm, close to the closed length. The antenna stands 16 mm above the body (layout_mm.parts). No spec gives the display diagonal: the LCD window measures about 33 x 23 mm; 1.44in at the native 96 x 72

key_icons: Small dark rounded keys in four columns, each digit with its small letters to its right; the fourth column reads a green handset (call), MEMO, C and a red handset (end). The 1 key also shows a small voicemail icon; the 0 key shows a space symbol and '+'; the # key shows '@'.
